provenance: original synthetic text and candidates authored for M11-G18; no real or private posting
authorship_disclosure: same author as the G10-G17 research; not independently annotated. Job texts were parsed while authoring to confirm each phrasing produces rows; the matcher, assessor and every policy ran only after the freeze.

categories.satisfied_by_observed_evidence: an acceptable alternative has observed GitHub evidence
categories.not_observed_fully_assessable: every alternative is evidenceable and none has evidence
categories.partially_observable_no_positive_evidenc: some alternative can never be evidenced and no evidenceable alternative has evidence -- absence proves nothing
categories.completely_non_assessable: no alternative can ever be evidenced
categories.structurally_ambiguous: the logical grouping itself cannot be determined from the text
categories.unsupported_related_evidence_only: evidence exists only for a related concept that is NOT an acceptable alternative (related is never entailment)
categories.compound_logic_contained: mixed AND/OR claim; G17 contract routes it to a non-scoreable placeholder
categories.non_technical_claim: education / soft skill / other claim GitHub evidence cannot speak to
categories.not_a_requirement: narrative or company text, not a candidate qualification
